purpose: Hold-out, local-ASR path: F01, a status readout with speech and no transcript. No earlier round asked about F01's readout (A-01 stopped at the missing tools); the skill, grader and help text were not tuned on it.

phases.prompt: This is a recording of a service readout, {{video}}; there is no transcript. Write me a one-line release note: the state the service is in and the build it reports. Use the VSift skill and the compact budget. When you have written the handoff, keep the evidence: I authorise you to retain the session to a new folder named {{bundle_dir}} in this directory with vsift session retain (without the video), and then leave the session open.
